parameters.content:
## Setup Instructions (Visual and Citation Edition)
1. Single API Key: Connect your Google Gemini Chat Model credential.
2. Zero-Cost Visual Engines Included:
   - Logos and Website Snapshots: Clearbit + WordPress MShots
   - Architecture Diagrams: Mermaid.ink SVG Renderer
   - Graphical Radar Charts: QuickChart.io Engine
   - Proofs and Citations Table: Clickable URLs from Google News RSS and Hacker News

## 1. Auto Domain Discovery and Parallel Scraping
Resolves the official domain and logo, then scrapes the official site, Google News RSS (with URLs), and Hacker News threads simultaneously.

## 2. Gemini Visual Synthesis and Rich PDF Generator
Generates quantitative scores, a Mermaid ecosystem diagram, verified source links, and compiles a print-ready visual PDF dossier.
